result.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
result.summary: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出免训练的 LatentParse：由一个 analyst VLM 借助预定义工具探测 CLIP、DINOv3 与 VGGT 的 latent 特征，完成物体定位、跨视角跟踪与视角间运动测量，再蒸馏为简短文本报告，与图像一同交给目标 VLM 回答多视角空间推理问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「视觉几何与跨视角对应信息是否留在内部表示中、又如何被 VLM 实际使用」这一主线，其文本化证据旁路可供核查是否缓解信息坍缩，以及收益中有多少来自 analyst 工具设计而非 latent 内容本身。
